name: Senyera (Spain)
description: Vertically divided white and green, charged at the centre with the uncrowned arms of Senyera (a water wheel on green, the bars of Aragon and a wing on white).
history: The official flag of Senyera is of proportions 2:3, party per pale, with the arms without the open royal crown occupying three fifths of the height of the flag; it was approved by resolution of 17 September 2021 of the Presidency of the Generalitat and published in the DOGV. The arms had been approved by resolution of 5 April 2019, published in the DOGV of 16 April 2019.

features.role: Senyera arms without a crown — water wheel on green, the bars of Aragon and a red wing on white
